caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object placed centrally against a plain, off-white background. The object is wedge-shaped, with one edge thicker and rounded, while the opposing edge is narrower and angled. It features a decorative design, highlighted in yellow and black. The black forms the base and provides the background, while the yellow overlays create an elaborate motif consisting of swirling scrolls and feather-like or leaf-like acanthus elements. There are curved lines, a rounded finial-like detail, and textured surface patterns on the yellow portions. The object's overall shape is reminiscent of a decorative bracket or corbel.
title: Billethead
